```{r}
# ============================================================
# 01_prepare_SLIDE_pleomorphic_input
# pILC SLIDE input: pleomorphic component cellularity (%)
# ============================================================

set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------
MOFA_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated"
SLIDE_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/SLIDE"

PREPARED_VIEWS_FILE <- file.path(
  MOFA_DIR,
  "MOFA2_RDS",
  "MOFA2_prepared_input_view_matrices.rds"
)

CLINICAL_FILE <- file.path(
  MOFA_DIR,
  "ClinicalCorrelation_clean_for_MOFA2.csv"
)

INPUT_DIR <- file.path(SLIDE_DIR, "Input_pleomorphic")
RESULTS_DIR <- file.path(SLIDE_DIR, "Results_pleomorphic")
LOG_DIR <- file.path(SLIDE_DIR, "Logs_pleomorphic")

dir.create(INPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(RESULTS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(LOG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

OUTCOME_COL <- "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity"

PRIMARY_VIEWS <- c(
  "RNA_VST_top5000var",
  "WES_mutation_recurrent",
  "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB"
)

MAX_TOTAL_FEATURES <- 5000L
MIN_MUTATION_PREVALENCE <- 2L

# ---------------------------
# Functions
# ---------------------------
clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- toupper(x)
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)

  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("T$", "", x)

  x <- sub("_N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("NL$", "", x)

  x <- sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)
  x
}

collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  if (!anyDuplicated(colnames(mat))) {
    return(mat)
  }

  unique_samples <- unique(colnames(mat))

  out <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(unique_samples, function(sample_id) {
      idx <- which(colnames(mat) == sample_id)

      # Same duplicate-column handling used in MOFA2 preparation:
      # average values for columns that resolve to the same sample ID.
      rowMeans(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  )

  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- unique_samples
  out
}

prepare_view <- function(mat, view_name) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  if (is.null(rownames(mat)) || is.null(colnames(mat))) {
    stop(view_name, " requires feature row names and sample column names.")
  }

  colnames(mat) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(mat))
  mat <- collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric(mat)

  if (any(!is.finite(mat))) {
    stop(view_name, " contains missing/non-finite values.")
  }

  mat
}

# ---------------------------
# Load the prepared MOFA2 matrices
# ---------------------------
if (!file.exists(PREPARED_VIEWS_FILE)) {
  stop("Cannot find:\n", PREPARED_VIEWS_FILE)
}

if (!file.exists(CLINICAL_FILE)) {
  stop("Cannot find:\n", CLINICAL_FILE)
}

view_mats <- readRDS(PREPARED_VIEWS_FILE)

missing_views <- setdiff(PRIMARY_VIEWS, names(view_mats))

if (length(missing_views) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These views are missing from the MOFA RDS:\n",
    paste(missing_views, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

view_mats <- view_mats[PRIMARY_VIEWS]

for (v in names(view_mats)) {
  view_mats[[v]] <- prepare_view(view_mats[[v]], v)

  message(
    v, ": ",
    nrow(view_mats[[v]]), " features x ",
    ncol(view_mats[[v]]), " samples"
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# Load continuous pleomorphic outcome
# TP08-1319 is now numeric 10 in the clinical CSV.
# ---------------------------
clinical <- read.csv(
  CLINICAL_FILE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (!all(c("Sample", OUTCOME_COL) %in% colnames(clinical))) {
  stop(
    "Clinical CSV requires these columns:\n",
    "Sample\n",
    OUTCOME_COL
  )
}

clinical$Sample <- clean_sample_id(clinical$Sample)

clinical$pleomorphic_component_pct <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(clinical[[OUTCOME_COL]])
)

clinical <- clinical[
  !is.na(clinical$Sample) &
    clinical$Sample != "" &
    is.finite(clinical$pleomorphic_component_pct),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (anyDuplicated(clinical$Sample) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate clinical Sample IDs remain after cleaning.")
}

message(
  "\nClinical samples with valid pleomorphic outcome: ",
  nrow(clinical)
)

# ---------------------------
# Audit samples across all three views
# ---------------------------
clinical_samples <- sort(clinical$Sample)

sample_audit <- data.frame(
  Sample = clinical_samples,
  pleomorphic_component_pct = clinical$pleomorphic_component_pct[
    match(clinical_samples, clinical$Sample)
  ],
  has_RNA = clinical_samples %in%
    colnames(view_mats$RNA_VST_top5000var),
  has_WES_mutation = clinical_samples %in%
    colnames(view_mats$WES_mutation_recurrent),
  has_IMPACT_mutation = clinical_samples %in%
    colnames(view_mats$IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sample_audit$included_in_SLIDE <-
  sample_audit$has_RNA &
  sample_audit$has_WES_mutation &
  sample_audit$has_IMPACT_mutation

write.table(
  sample_audit,
  file = file.path(INPUT_DIR, "SLIDE_sample_availability_audit.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

availability_summary <- data.frame(
  clinical_pleomorphic_samples = nrow(sample_audit),
  RNA_available = sum(sample_audit$has_RNA),
  WES_mutation_available = sum(sample_audit$has_WES_mutation),
  IMPACT_mutation_available = sum(sample_audit$has_IMPACT_mutation),
  complete_multiomics = sum(sample_audit$included_in_SLIDE)
)

print(availability_summary)

# ---------------------------
# Select complete multi-omics cohort
# ---------------------------
common_view_samples <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(view_mats, colnames)
)

model_samples <- sort(
  intersect(common_view_samples, clinical$Sample)
)

if (length(model_samples) <= 15) {
  stop(
    "Only ", length(model_samples),
    " complete samples are available. SLIDE requires more than 15."
  )
}

message("\nFinal SLIDE cohort: ", length(model_samples), " samples")

write.table(
  data.frame(sample = model_samples),
  file = file.path(INPUT_DIR, "model_samples.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# Construct X: samples x features
# ---------------------------
x_views <- list()
feature_manifest_list <- list()

for (v in names(view_mats)) {
  mat <- view_mats[[v]][, model_samples, drop = FALSE]

  if (v == "RNA_VST_top5000var") {
    feature_variance <- apply(mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

    mat <- mat[
      order(feature_variance, decreasing = TRUE),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  } else {
    mutation_prevalence <- rowSums(mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE)

    mat <- mat[
      mutation_prevalence >= MIN_MUTATION_PREVALENCE,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  original_features <- rownames(mat)

  # View prefix makes every SLIDE feature ID unique.
  slide_features <- paste0(
    v,
    "__",
    make.unique(original_features)
  )

  rownames(mat) <- slide_features
  x_views[[v]] <- t(mat)

  feature_manifest_list[[v]] <- data.frame(
    SLIDE_feature = slide_features,
    original_feature = original_features,
    source_view = v,
    feature_type = ifelse(
      v == "RNA_VST_top5000var",
      "RNA_expression",
      "mutation"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Retain all eligible mutation features.
# Fill remaining places with highest-variance RNA features.
non_rna_views <- setdiff(
  names(x_views),
  "RNA_VST_top5000var"
)

n_non_rna_features <- sum(
  vapply(x_views[non_rna_views], ncol, integer(1))
)

n_rna_allowed <- MAX_TOTAL_FEATURES - n_non_rna_features

if (n_rna_allowed < 500L) {
  stop(
    "Too many eligible mutation features (",
    n_non_rna_features,
    ") to create a stable 5,000-feature matrix."
  )
}

n_rna_keep <- min(
  ncol(x_views$RNA_VST_top5000var),
  n_rna_allowed
)

x_views$RNA_VST_top5000var <-
  x_views$RNA_VST_top5000var[
    ,
    seq_len(n_rna_keep),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

feature_manifest_list$RNA_VST_top5000var <-
  feature_manifest_list$RNA_VST_top5000var[
    seq_len(n_rna_keep),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

x <- do.call(cbind, x_views)
storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"

feature_sd <- apply(x, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_features <- is.finite(feature_sd) & feature_sd > 0

if (any(!keep_features)) {
  message(
    "Removing ", sum(!keep_features),
    " zero-variance feature(s)."
  )

  x <- x[, keep_features, drop = FALSE]
}

if (any(!is.finite(x))) {
  stop("Final X matrix contains missing/non-finite values.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(x)) > 0) {
  stop("Final X matrix contains duplicate feature names.")
}

# ---------------------------
# Construct Y: samples x 1 outcome
# ---------------------------
y_values <- clinical$pleomorphic_component_pct[
  match(rownames(x), clinical$Sample)
]

if (anyNA(y_values) || any(!is.finite(y_values))) {
  stop("Missing outcome values remain after matching.")
}

y <- matrix(
  as.numeric(y_values),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(
    rownames(x),
    "pleomorphic_component_pct"
  )
)

if (!identical(rownames(x), rownames(y))) {
  stop("X and Y sample ordering differs.")
}

# ---------------------------
# Write SLIDE inputs
# ---------------------------
x_file <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "x.csv")
y_file <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "y.csv")
yaml_file <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "slide_pleomorphic.yaml")

write.csv(
  x,
  file = x_file,
  row.names = TRUE,
  quote = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  y,
  file = y_file,
  row.names = TRUE,
  quote = FALSE
)

feature_manifest <- do.call(rbind, feature_manifest_list)

feature_manifest <- feature_manifest[
  match(colnames(x), feature_manifest$SLIDE_feature),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

write.table(
  feature_manifest,
  file = file.path(INPUT_DIR, "feature_manifest.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

input_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "outcome",
    "n_samples",
    "n_features",
    "RNA_features",
    "WES_mutation_features",
    "IMPACT_mutation_features",
    "outcome_min",
    "outcome_median",
    "outcome_max"
  ),
  value = c(
    "pleomorphic_component_pct",
    nrow(x),
    ncol(x),
    sum(feature_manifest$source_view == "RNA_VST_top5000var"),
    sum(feature_manifest$source_view == "WES_mutation_recurrent"),
    sum(feature_manifest$source_view == "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB"),
    min(y),
    median(y),
    max(y)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.table(
  input_summary,
  file = file.path(INPUT_DIR, "input_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# SLIDE YAML settings
# ---------------------------
params <- list(
  x_path = x_file,
  y_path = y_file,
  out_path = RESULTS_DIR,
  delta = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  lambda = c(0.5, 1.0),
  spec = 0.1,
  y_factor = FALSE,
  y_levels = NULL,
  eval_type = "corr",
  SLIDE_iter = 1000,
  SLIDE_top_feats = 15,
  sampleCV_iter = 500,
  sampleCV_K = 4,
  do_interacts = FALSE,
  thresh_fdr = 0.2,
  fdr = 0.1
)

yaml::write_yaml(params, yaml_file)

saveRDS(
  list(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    params = params,
    model_samples = model_samples,
    sample_audit = sample_audit,
    feature_manifest = feature_manifest
  ),
  file.path(INPUT_DIR, "slide_input_objects.rds")
)

# ---------------------------
# Validate using SLIDE
# ---------------------------
x_check <- as.matrix(
  read.csv(x_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
)

y_check <- as.matrix(
  read.csv(y_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
)

if (!identical(rownames(x_check), rownames(y_check))) {
  stop("Written X and Y files have different sample order.")
}

SLIDE::checkDataParams(params)

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(
    LOG_DIR,
    "01_prepare_SLIDE_pleomorphic_sessionInfo.txt"
  )
)

message("\nSLIDE input preparation completed successfully.")
message("X dimensions: ", nrow(x), " samples x ", ncol(x), " features")
message("Y dimensions: ", nrow(y), " samples x 1 continuous outcome")
message("Input directory: ", INPUT_DIR)
```
